subject: Feature approval request: AvaTech customer highlight (visuals, quote)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Sullivan <liam.osullivan@avatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Feature approval request: AvaTech customer highlight (visuals, quote)

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. We pulled together a short customer highlight draft and a couple of visuals that show the latency/cost improvements you saw after migration. Before we publish on the Redwood site and include in our Q1 sales kit, could you confirm the following: 

1) Permission to use the short quote you provided in the demo: "Redwood helped us cut inference latency by 3x and reduced generation cost by 40%."
2) Permission to use two screenshots (attached) showing the dashboard and the performance graph
3) Any logo usage constraints — we attached a proposed placement and a small logo pack for your legal/comms to review.

Attachments: avatech_screenshots_v2.png, mutual_action_plan_avatech.pdf, avatech_logo_guidelines.pdf

If you can loop in whoever signs off on brand usage, that would be great — copying Marissa from our side who will coordinate next steps. We hope to publish the highlight the week of Nov 16.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Liam O'Sullivan <liam.osullivan@avatech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Press Team <press@avatech.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Feature approval request: AvaTech customer highlight (visuals, quote)

Hi Ben —

Appreciate the draft. Quick answers:
- The quote is fine, but we'd prefer to replace "3x" with "around 3x" for accuracy in public materials.
- Screenshots look good, but legal will want the underlying numbers redacted in the graph legend (customer IDs).
- I'll loop in our comms team and legal — CC'd Press Team here.

I'll aim to get a definitive sign-off by Thursday. In the meantime, can you confirm whether we need a signed release (DocuSign) or if an email approval from our legal will suffice?

Cheers,
Liam
Head of Product Marketing | AvaTech
liam.osullivan@avatech.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Sullivan <liam.osullivan@avatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Feature approval request: AvaTech customer highlight (visuals, quote)

Hi Liam —

Thanks — we can absolutely change the quote to "around 3x" and redact the customer IDs from the graph. We typically take either: 

- an explicit email approval from an authorized legal/comms contact (fine for press/website highlights), or
- a short signed release for our records (DocuSign link) when customers want the release to live as a formal asset.

Given you mentioned legal, I CC'd Laura from our comms/legal team to advise on wording and whether we should push a DocuSign. Laura — any hard constraints on logo placement/size we should be aware of?

Next steps on our side: we will prepare a revised set of visuals with redacted legend and updated quote, then send a one-page release if you prefer DocuSign. Proposed publish target remains week of Nov 16.

Best,
Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Sullivan <liam.osullivan@avatech.com>, Press Team <press@avatech.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Feature approval request: AvaTech customer highlight (visuals, quote)

Hi all —

Reviewed the materials. High-level: happy to proceed with the edits Ben proposed. A few specific conditions from our side: 

- Quote: change to "around 3x" as requested by AvaTech.
- Screenshots: redaction of internal IDs is required (Ben, please send the redacted PNGs).
- Logo: we request the small redwood mark sits to the right of the headline, minimum clear space 8px and no smaller than 40px width on the site. We will also include a short attribution note: "AvaTech is a Redwood Inference customer."
- Attribution/approval: an email from an AvaTech legal/comms contact confirming the above is acceptable. If AvaTech prefers DocuSign, we can execute that as well.

I attached a one-page display release template for your convenience (mutual_action_plan_avatech.pdf contains the redlined release). Once we have the redacted visuals and the final quote text from Liam/legal, Marissa will coordinate publication timing and assets.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Communications & Legal Liaison | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Liam O'Sullivan <liam.osullivan@avatech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Feature approval request: AvaTech customer highlight (visuals, quote)

Hi everyone —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Our comms lead (Press Team) reviewed and confirms:
- Quote updated to: "Redwood helped us reduce inference latency to around 3x and lowered generation cost by 40%."
- Screenshots: redacted images attached (see Drive link).
- Logo: approved with the size/clear-space restrictions noted by Laura.

We are fine with email approval — attaching signed confirmation via DocuSign here for your records: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/signed-avatech-feature-2026

Please proceed with the revised assets. We prefer the customer highlight go live no earlier than Nov 18 to align with an internal product announcement.

Warm regards,
Liam O'Sullivan
Head of Product Marketing | AvaTech
liam.osullivan@avatech.com

Attachments: avatech_screenshots_v2_redacted.png
